set.t: Legend with no fixed spot; the pin is the Heights hill named in 1913, and the 1937 coin finds were on the river bluff south of town (about 1-2 km), inside the ring. An 1851 coin is too late for an 1830s-40s payroll, so the finds may be unrelated losses. Effigy Mounds National Monument and Pikes Peak State Park (on the bluffs south of McGregor) are no-dig; McGregor Heights is residential. The 'Gold Mine' farm was most likely in sec 26 T95N R4W, Giard Township, about 6 mi west of McGregor (farmstead near 43.0140,-91.2812 with wooded bluffs and ravines to the north; the same family held it in 1965, not checked on a 1930s plat). Private: permission. Access: private / state and federal land near: look only.
